metadata.title: Threat-intel & IR firms in the IQT web (SIGINT-adjacent commercial)

notes: Ported from bubble-map In-Q-Tel portfolio deep-dive. These are the commercial threat-intel / RF-geoint / OSINT firms IQT seeded - the protector/intel side of the same venture web as the surveillance vendors. A cheque is still not operational control.

entities.name: FireEye
entities.notes: Threat-intel + incident response (Mandiant). Early In-Q-Tel investee. Mandiant published APT1 (2013) attributing PLA Unit 61398, and discovered the SolarWinds/SUNBURST intrusion (2020). Google acquired Mandiant (2022, ~$5.4B) into Google Cloud security.

entities.name: Cylance
entities.notes: AI endpoint security (pre-CrowdStrike-era ML antivirus). In-Q-Tel-backed; acquired by BlackBerry (2018, ~$1.4B).

entities.name: HawkEye_360
entities.notes: Smallsat constellations geolocating RF emissions (ships going dark, jamming, comms) - space-based signals intelligence as a service. In-Q-Tel-backed; sells RF-geolocation to NGA/defense/IC.

entities.name: Fivecast
entities.notes: OSINT / social-media risk analytics used by IC + law enforcement. In-Q-Tel-backed (Australian-origin, Five Eyes).

entities.name: NGA
entities.notes: National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency. Buyer of commercial geoint/RF (HawkEye 360, Planet-type imagery) - the tasking hub wiring commercial-space SIGINT-adjacent data into the IC.

entities.name: BlackBerry
entities.notes: Pivoted from handsets to security software; owns Cylance endpoint AI and QNX embedded OS.

entities.name: SIGINT_Collection
entities.notes: Signals intelligence - RF/comms interception and geolocation. Historically a state monopoly (NSA/GCHQ); HawkEye 360-class commercial constellations now sell RF-geoint as a service, blurring the state/commercial line.

entities.name: OSINT_Collection
entities.notes: Open-source / social-media intelligence (SOCMINT): harvesting and analytics over public data. Sold commercially (Fivecast) to IC + law enforcement - lower legal bar than SIGINT, expanding fast.
